scope: Private scalar draft only. No completed jobs2/3, public integration, complete fuzz, new-Wasm GPU upload, peak-memory, final entry or timing acceptance.
method: Preserve rational pre-byte UASTC interpolation (scale64); use uniform UNORM5 ETC1S expansion plus modifier (scale31) as an experimental symmetric-residual source estimate. Complete discrete endpoint search across both modes scores the rational target, always enforcing the original visible-byte bound. No source/filename/old optimizer/per-file tuning at runtime; no normative decode replacement.

Payloads captured during this same campaign, avoiding repeat transcodes for follow-up analysis.
